topics.definition: Vector indexing organizes embeddings for fast similarity search.
tips: Choose an index based on data size and speed requirements.

topics.definition: Similarity search finds vectors closest to a query embedding.
ANN algorithms speed up vector search by finding near-optimal neighbors efficiently.
tips: Trade a small amount of accuracy for speed when needed.

topics.definition: A query pipeline embeds the query, retrieves candidates and prepares context.
tips: Cache frequent queries to improve performance.

topics.definition: Metadata filtering narrows search results using attributes such as date or category.
tips: Store useful metadata with each document.

topics.definition: Vector search powers semantic search, recommendations and RAG systems.
Measure vector search using recall, latency, throughput and accuracy.
Use quality embeddings, optimize indexes and monitor retrieval quality.
